subsections.text_before_clauses: For ascertaining the fair market value of a capital asset for this Chapter, the Assessing Officer may refer the valuation of the capital asset to a Valuation Officer,—

clauses.text: if the value of the asset claimed by the assessee is as per the estimate by a registered valuer, but the Assessing Officer is of the opinion that the value so claimed is at variance with its fair market value;

clauses.text_before_sub_clauses: in any other case, if the Assessing Officer is of the opinion that—

sub_clauses.text: the fair market value of the asset exceeds the value claimed by the assessee by more than the percentage of value of such asset or amount, as may be prescribed; or
having regard to the nature of the asset and other relevant circumstances, it is necessary so to do.

subsections.text: The provisions of section 269(3) to (8) shall, with necessary modifications, apply in relation to such reference made under sub-section (1).

orphans.text: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
